mechanism: Atovaquone may reduce spironolactone absorption through gastric pH alteration and potential inhibition of intestinal transporters, while spironolactone's potassium-retaining effects combined with atovaquone use may increase hyperkalemia risk in certain patient populations.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function; ensure adequate dietary fat intake with atovaquone to optimize absorption; separate dosing if possible and monitor for reduced spironolactone efficacy.
